requirements.text: I want to close the case number - "CS-0000944".
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 944 AND state = 'closed'
assumptions: CS-0000944 is case 944, of account 41 (Thomas Group), in state resolved on the seed
resolved to closed is a valid transition under the policy, so the case can be closed directly from its seed state
closed_on is a server-kept timestamp and is not tested

requirements.text: Create a knowledge article ... with the title "Thomas Group issue", body as '...' and author as Jason Morrison.

cells.title: Thomas Group issue
cells.body: This issue is not related to any ServiceNow product directly, it occurred due to dependency on other products.

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 370 AND title = 'Thomas Group issue' AND body = 'This issue is not related to any ServiceNow product directly, it occurred due to dependency on other products.' AND owner_id = 84 AND state = 'published' AND visibility = 'internal'
requirements.source: Verify the new knowledge is created.
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest knowledge_id 369)
author is the owner: the policy tracks ownership through owner_id; Jason Morrison is user 84, the only user of that name and the acting user
body is fixed word for word by the request; the benchmark check does not test it
visibility internal: the policy makes every newly created article internal until reviewed
state published: the policy allows only published articles to be linked to a case, and the article must be linked

requirements.text: Create a knowledge article to document this resolution for future reference
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 944 AND knowledge_id = 370 AND used_as = 'resolution'
requirements.source: Verify new knowledge is linked to the case.
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: the policy says a knowledge article created for a case should be linked to it for future reference
id assumed next in sequence (highest case_kb_id 527)
used_as resolution: the policy gives resolution for an article created after the case's resolution

requirements.text: I checked there is no relevant knowledge article present for this.
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 944 AND knowledge_id <> 370
assumptions: the request rules out every existing article as relevant, so no article other than the new one is linked to case 944; the case has no links on the seed

notes:
No benchmark check tests the case closure, although the request opens with it, so it is a new requirement. closed_on is a timestamp the policy says to capture on closure; it is server-kept and already set on the seed, so it is not tested.
The request gives the title and body verbatim, so the policy's knowledge title and body templates are not applied; the title (18 characters) is below the policy's 30-character minimum for free-form text, but the request states it and the benchmark tests it, so it is kept as given.
The article's product_id is not fixed by the request or policy (case 944 has no product) and is not tested.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that no article other than the new one is linked to case 944: one pass wrote it, the other did not; kept because the request says no relevant article exists, so linking any existing article to the case would contradict it.
